name: Zimone, Infinite Analyst
oracle_text:
The first spell you cast with {X} in its mana cost each turn costs {1} less to cast for each +1/+1 counter on Zimone.
Whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, put two +1/+1 counters on Zimone.
blocked_sentences: The first spell you cast with {X} in its mana cost each turn costs {1} less to cast for each +1/+1 counter on Zimone.
Whenever you cast your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn, put two +1/+1 counters on Zimone.

needs.what: a spell_cast trigger filter key that matches a spell whose printed mana cost contains {X} (the selector-side `x_in_mana_cost: true`), honoured by the trigger matcher and counted by the `nth` ordinal so `nth: 1` with `filter: {x_in_mana_cost: true}` means "your first spell with {X} in its mana cost each turn"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys has `mana_cost`, but that is an exact printed-cost list match (printed_cost_is), so it cannot say 'any cost containing {X}'. `x_in_mana_cost` exists only as a selector key and a mana_restriction predicate; the trigger matcher and the spell_cast ordinal never read it

needs.what: a spell_cost_reduction whose affects_spells can match a spell with {X} in its printed mana cost (`x_in_mana_cost: true`) and that applies only to the first such spell its controller casts each turn, with amount {counters_on: self, kind +1/+1}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction_filter_keys has no x_in_mana_cost (only the exact-cost `mana_cost`), and spell_cost_reduction (player_statics.spell_cost_reduction) carries no per-turn 'first spell' limit; a static `condition` cmp on spells_cast_this_turn with a filter could gate it, but that filter goes through _matches_printed, which also cannot say 'contains {X}'
